purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system for Japanese medical billing. It appears to aggregate and compute point/score totals broken down by medical treatment category (診療区分別点数集計) for inpatient receipt processing. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65, RECE69) related to medical receipt records.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in a Japanese character encoding (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but was decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake in the comment lines. The COBOL structure itself is unambiguous. The COPY statements reference .INC files which are copybooks not included in this excerpt. The program is clearly a production medical billing component from the open-source ORCA project maintained by the Japan Medical Association, with a detailed revision history spanning 2002–2006.
